protocol.scope: Bounded retrieval workflow following explicitly authored reference graphs. No LLM, automatic interpretation of questions, generated answer or agent.
protocol.matrix: 4 effective login roles × 11 predefined scenarios = 44 workflows. Actual PostgreSQL RLS reads; original corpus unchanged.
protocol.task: requiredKeys is a typed workflow requirement supplied in each authored case, not a gold document ID fed to a model. Evaluation separately compares authorized document IDs fixed before capture.
protocol.budget: Count one SQL full-text search or one direct ID lookup as one source call; principal/identity reads excluded and reported separately. MaxCalls 0..6; maxSources 1..8; maxQueuedReferences 1..32. No duration, provider-token or latency benchmark.
protocol.references: Graphs authored before execution, including broken/cyclic/cross-tenant controls. Only expand links of documents actually returned under current RLS. Follow ordered frontier, deduplicate attempted IDs. Links never grant access.
protocol.transactions: One REPEATABLE READ READ ONLY transaction per workflow, current principal loaded first. No simultaneous revocation tested.
protocol.metrics: Authorized target-document coverage, null when target set empty. Not factual support, natural language task success or answer completeness. Preserve all outcomes.
protocol.preservation: Do not overwrite successful or failed artifact. Changed sources or graphs require a new protocol/path.

runtime.network: loopback ephemeral port; temporary synthetic databases only
runtime.authentication: trust ONLY in disposable loopback lab; not a deployment configuration
